title: Pilih Dunia Visual Prolabios Light
question: The roll assigned Trade Show Booth (kandidat #3). Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Trade Show Booth
options.lineage: Indonesian industrial trade show display systems (Labex, Indo Lab, Medlab)
options.thesis: The catalog as a trade show floor: modular, high-energy, scan-first—where every product panel is a booth stop and the Ruby–Sunny brand colors function as exhibitor signage.
options.viewport: Full-width hero with strong horizontal scan: Prolabios logo left, headline mid, RFQ CTA Sunny-yellow right. Below: Ruby category navigation tabs. Grid of product cards on Natural ground.
options.risk: Can read as generic exhibition if module rhythm loses its energy—requires committed density and bold type scale.

raised.raise: Module grid carries consistent rhythmic repetition—every product card is an equal edition in the floor plan.
Buttons and CTAs own confident thick outlines with enough rounding to feel approachable, never corporate.
Catalog codes (CAT. XXXX) and spec numbers render in monospace with high contrast—typographic authority at small scale.
Product tags and category labels follow a structured provenance-label system: code first, name second, always legible.
Hero and section surfaces carry a subtle paper grain texture warming the Natural ground.

options.label: Kemasan Reagen Eropa
options.lineage: European lab reagent label systems (Merck, Sigma-Aldrich, VWR catalog design)
options.thesis: The platform as a reagent label: every surface is a precision-printed label system where Ruby bands denote hazard/category, Sunny marks safe CTA zones, and Natural is the substrate.
options.viewport: Full-width category band header in Ruby, product grid with white cards on Natural ground, category color dots as the only decoration.
options.risk: Also where most lab-sector design runs land—familiar, effective, but the most conventional direction in this category.

options.label: FMCG Indonesia Packaging
options.lineage: Indonesian consumer FMCG packaging energy (Indomie, Kopiko, Antangin era)
options.thesis: Fused: warm bold consumer energy applied to B2B product grid. High identification with Indonesian visual culture.
options.viewport: Bold Ruby header block, grid of product cards with strong color-coded edges, Sunny badge CTAs.
options.case: Strong audience identification—Indonesian buyers recognize this warmth. Loses narrowly on professional credibility vs. trade show world.
options.risk: Slides into consumer-retail if Ruby and Sunny are not handled with enough restraint at B2B scale.
options.verdict_explanation: competitive — strong identification, narrow product clarity loss

options.label: Silkscreen Factory Loft
options.viewport: Off-register portrait grid of product repeats.
options.case: Audience identification: lab procurement officers read this as an art studio. Product clarity: lost in the aesthetic. Declined.
options.verdict_explanation: declined — donated: module rhythm → assigned direction's grid consistency raise

options.label: Rubber-Hose Cel
options.viewport: Iris-framed centered product card with bouncy controls.
options.case: Zero audience identification for B2B lab procurement. Declined.
options.verdict_explanation: declined — donated: button confidence and thick outlines → assigned direction's CTA style raise

options.label: Standar Kategori
options.thesis: Clean white ground, blue primary links, table-driven catalog—the safe enterprise web look.
options.viewport: Standard navbar, hero banner, card grid, footer.
options.risk: Exactly what every competitor in this category ships.

reroll.safer: Indonesian lab equipment catalog in Merck/VWR style—competitor-comparable, credential-first.
reroll.bolder: Batik motif reinterpreted as information grid—indigenous Indonesian pattern as navigation system.
